data.name: Aisha
data.gender_notes: Aisha is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-ي-ش (ʿ-y-sh), 'to live'. ʿĀʾisha means 'living, alive, prosperous'. Aisha therefore means “Alive; living; prosperous”. Borne by ʿĀʾisha bint Abī Bakr, wife of the Prophet ﷺ.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aisha expresses “Alive; living; prosperous”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-ي-ش (ʿ-y-sh), 'to live'. ʿĀʾisha means 'living, alive, prosperous'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aisha total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

faq.q: What does the name Aisha mean?
Where does the name Aisha come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aisha?
faq.a: The root of Aisha is ع-ي-ش (ʿ-y-sh).

faq.q: How is Aisha written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aisha is written عَائِشَة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aisha a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aisha is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aisha appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aisha is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aisha verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Alive; living; prosperous” is established by Borne by ʿĀʾisha bint Abī Bakr, wife of the Prophet ﷺ..
